about: The values Settings start with until the user sets their own (settings.json in the user config folder). Nothing here is assumed by the code: a missing or broken file is an error naming it.

sources.impedance_tolerance_pct: How far routed impedance may stray from a net class's target, in percent, when the class states no tolerance of its own. ±10 % is the controlled-impedance tolerance fabricators commonly offer as standard, tighter values usually being a special order; it is also the value the impedance check used before it became a setting. Set your fabricator's stated tolerance in Settings.
